name: ceramics-webapp
description: The single-page storefront: a public catalog and guest/signed-in checkout for Shoppers, plus a Store Admin console (catalog and order management) served from the same bundle with role-scoped screens. Talks only to ceramics-api for data; holds no secrets and never calls payment or email providers directly.

dependencies.name: ceramics-api
dependencies.description: Calls the Ceramics API for catalog, cart, checkout, order, and admin management operations.

dependencies.name: thunder-auth
dependencies.description: Thunder SSO client for optional shopper sign-in and required Store Admin sign-in; provides the OIDC login/PKCE flow in-browser.
